parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1267250. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements: standard_relation '=' and non-null standard_value and standard_relation. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
